answer: A falcon courier keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must fly its own falcon along a cipher route that reveals one waypoint at a time, starting from the nadir of a cold valley. The nth fake owes a flight whose legs triple and add one: the first 1 mile, the second 4, the third 13, the fourth 40, the fifth 121, so the tenth fake alone flies 29,524 miles and twenty fakes together fly 2,615,088,290. Bulk farming fails because one falcon flies one route and no flock flies two routes at once, like one rider riding one road, one horse. Each waypoint is flown fresh, never bought.
